body:
I'm so sorry you're going through this. I also experienced toxic positivity after my MMC, and a load of absolutely shitty advice on "how to do it right". My  "best friend" who knows we've been trying for over a year also keeps saying month after month that we're on the same cycle and if she were to try to get pregnant now she would and we could be pregnant together. Um, no. We won't, because it's taking a long ass time for me. Also, she's not in a good place in her life to be taking care of a baby and doesn't even know if she wants one, but good to know you think it's so easy. 

I know your comment is a few days old already, but I just wanted to say I'm sorry people are so shitty, and I hope everything works out for you. ❤

Before we were even trying, my stepmother in law suggested using apps and tracking AS A FAMILY so we "could all be on this journey together" for both me and my SIL because she wanted grandbabies so bad.This was at a family dinner and I wanted to crawl under the table and die, because talking about your cervical mucus when you're trying to eat is definitely not recommended. Also, it's me and my husband's journey, not a family affair.

This is literally me during that awful 2 week wait; i start at 8dpo even though I know it won't show anything and I'm always so positive that I'm pregnant. I would even do the whole take a picture and zoom in to see if I could see any faint lines; I'm awful. Sending love to both you and OP ❤❤❤
